images.title: Square of side 6 cm
images.purpose: Show the finished square PQRS built from a 6 cm base with two right angles and two equal arcs, ending with all sides 6 cm.
images.composition: One large square centred on white space, with two thin grey compass arcs at the top corners; nothing else.
images.exact_structure: One square PQRS, sides drawn exactly equal, outline teal #0072B2. P bottom left, Q bottom right, R top right, S top left. Small right-angle marks at all 4 corners. Two thin grey #6B7280 arcs: one centred at P through S, one centred at Q through R. Bottom side PQ labelled 6 cm. Exactly 1 square, 4 right-angle marks, 2 arcs.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
arcs drawn as full circles, or any side drawn longer or shorter than the others
images.takeaway: Every side is 6 cm and every angle is 90 degrees.
images.description: Square PQRS with side PQ marked 6 cm, four right-angle marks and two grey arcs showing how S and R were found.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say which two lengths the compass arcs copy, then read the 6 cm side.

image_decisions.why: One clean geometry picture carries the single idea of this video.
